newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PIACENZA WIN TO FIGHT ANOTHER SEASON IN SERIE A.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PIACENZA WIN TO FIGHT ANOTHER SEASON IN SERIE A.

text.p: Two goals from striker Pasquale Luiso, one in injury time, helped Piacenza seal their survival in serie A when they beat Cagliari 3-1 in a relegation play-off in Naples on Sunday.
The match, along with the last day of the serie B season, completed the line-up of 18 clubs who will contest next season's league title.

Brescia, Empoli, Lecce and Bari all move up to the top league next season, trading places with relegated Reggiana, Verona, Perugia and Cagliari, who now face their first season in the second division since 1989-90.
The Sardinian club were behind just seven minutes into the match against Piacenza when Luiso scored. They never looked like challenging their rivals, who were promoted to serie A in 1995.

An own goal from Daniele Berretta, who deflected a Giuseppe Scienza shot into his own net, put Piacenza 2-0 up at halftime but the interval score could have been 3-0 had Piacenza's Fabian Valtolina not fluffed a penalty shot.
Sandro Tovalieri scored Cagliari's consolation goal in the second half before Luiso put the result beyond all doubt with another goal in the second minute of injury time.
He earned a yellow card for ripping off his shirt and parading along the edge of the pitch in jubilation but it was a small price to pay for survival in serie A.
Brescia had already been sure of promotion before Sunday's matches but made sure they did so in style by topping the serie B table with a 3-1 win against Venezia.

Empoli secured their return to the top flight for the first time in 10 years with a 1-0 victory away to bottom club Cremonese. Lecce won 3-0 at Cesena while Bari ended a season's exile in serie B with a 3-1 home victory over Castel di Sangro.
